title: Kirby Falling
blurb: A tiny descending whistle, and the pink puffball drops with absolutely no urgency whatsoever. Where the Goofy yell is pure panic, this is serene acceptance — Kirby is falling, Kirby is fine with it, Kirby will inhale something on the way down. Nintendo's sound design for the character is relentlessly gentle, which is amusing given he is canonically capable of destroying planets. Use it for soft failures, slow-motion drops and anyone tumbling adorably rather than dangerously. The official whistle of surrendering to gravity with dignity fully intact.
origin: Kirby's falling whistle from the Nintendo series.
